name: Atlassian Suite
description: Provides Atlassian credentials and the optional Source Control branch widget. Currently structural only — the Jira/Bitbucket API integration ships in a future iteration.

email.label: Atlassian Email
email.description: Email address tied to your Atlassian account. Required for the future API integration that will verify Jira tickets and look up Bitbucket pull requests. The API token paired with this email is stored separately in VS Code's SecretStorage and managed from this module's panel — it is not entered here.

jiraBase.label: Jira Base URL
jiraBase.description: Base URL the branch widget combines with the extracted ticket key to form Jira ticket links: <jiraBase>/browse/<KEY>. Trailing slashes are stripped automatically. Change this if your Atlassian instance lives at a non-default domain.

bitbucketWorkspace.label: Bitbucket Workspace
bitbucketWorkspace.description: Bitbucket Cloud workspace slug used as a fallback when the local repo's git remote URL cannot be parsed. Normally auto-detected from origin's URL; this value only takes effect when auto-detection fails.

showWidget.label: Show Branch Widget
showWidget.description: Toggles visibility of the Nomeda Branch Widget in the Source Control sidebar. When on, the widget extracts the ticket key from the current branch name and offers one-click links to the Jira ticket and Bitbucket branch/PR page. When off, the widget is fully hidden from the SCM container.
